Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows mild leukopenia, anemia, and thrombocytopenia, suggesting possible bone marrow suppression or chronic disease. There is evidence of dyslipidemia (high total cholesterol, LDL, triglycerides, low HDL) and poor glycemic control (elevated HbA1c), increasing cardiovascular risk. Mildly elevated ALT may indicate hepatic involvement. Glucose is slightly low. Renal and electrolyte parameters are within normal limits. Clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
